def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rects = []
    for r1 in range(h):
        for r2 in range(r1 + 2, h):
            for c1 in range(w):
                color = grid[r1][c1]
                if color == 0:
                    continue
                for c2 in range(c1 + 2, w):
                    if (grid[r1][c2] != color or grid[r2][c1] != color or
                        grid[r2][c2] != color):
                        continue
                    if (all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c1, c2 + 1)) and
                        all(grid[r2][c] == color for c in range(c1, c2 + 1)) and
                        all(grid[r][c1] == color and grid[r][c2] == color
                            for r in range(r1 + 1, r2))):
                        rects.append((r1, r2, c1, c2, color))
    outer = sorted(rects, key=lambda q: (q[1]-q[0])*(q[3]-q[2]), reverse=True)[:2]
    outer.sort(key=lambda q: (q[0], q[2]))
    panels = []
    for o in outer:
        r1, r2, c1, c2, oc = o
        boxes = [q for q in rects if q != o and q[0] > r1 and q[1] < r2
                 and q[2] > c1 and q[3] < c2]
        boxes.sort(key=lambda q: (q[0], q[2]))
        for q in boxes[:2]:
            panels.append([row[q[2]+1:q[3]] for row in grid[q[0]+1:q[1]]])
    target = outer[1][4]
    noise = max(max(row) for row in grid)
    same_shape = all(len(p) == len(panels[0]) and len(p[0]) == len(panels[0][0])
                     for p in panels)
    if same_shape:
        ph, pw = len(panels[0]), len(panels[0][0])
        result = [[0] * pw for _ in range(ph)]
        for y in range(ph):
            for x in range(pw):
                vals = [p[y][x] for p in panels]
                parity = sum(v != 0 for v in vals) % 2
                if parity:
                    nonzero = [v for v in vals if v]
                    result[y][x] = noise if all(v == noise for v in nonzero) else target
        return result
    # Normalize the unequal demonstration panels and mirror the upper pair.
    ph = min(len(p) for p in panels)
    pw = min(len(p[0]) for p in panels)
    normalized = []
    for i, p in enumerate(panels):
        start = len(p) - ph if i >= 2 else 0
        q = [row[:pw] for row in p[start:start+ph]]
        if i < 2:
            q = [list(reversed(row)) for row in q]
        normalized.append(q)
    result = [[0] * pw for _ in range(ph)]
    for y in range(ph):
        for x in range(pw):
            a, b = normalized[0][y][x], normalized[1][y][x]
            top = a if a and not b else b if b and not a else 0
            bottom_values = [normalized[i][y][x] for i in (2, 3)]
            bottom = next((v for v in reversed(bottom_values) if v), 0)
            value = bottom or top
            if value:
                result[y][x] = noise if value == noise else target
    return result

def transform(grid):
    # Extract the four monochrome frames; the two widest full-height bands contain
    # one 5x5 template and one 5x5 occlusion mask each.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bands=[]
    for r1 in range(h):
        for r2 in range(r1+2,h):
            for c1 in range(w):
                col=grid[r1][c1]
                if not col: continue
                for c2 in range(c1+2,w):
                    if all(grid[r][c]==col for r,c in
                           [(r1,x) for x in range(c1,c2+1)]+[(r2,x) for x in range(c1,c2+1)]+
                           [(y,c1) for y in range(r1+1,r2)]+[(y,c2) for y in range(r1+1,r2)]):
                        bands.append((r1,r2,c1,c2,col))
    outer=sorted(bands,key=lambda q:(q[1]-q[0])*(q[3]-q[2]),reverse=True)[:2]
    outer.sort()
    panels=[]
    for o in outer:
        r1,r2,c1,c2,col=o
        inner=[q for q in bands if q!=o and q[0]>r1 and q[1]<r2 and q[2]>c1 and q[3]<c2]
        inner.sort()
        panels += [[row[q[2]+1:q[3]] for row in grid[q[0]+1:q[1]]] for q in inner[:2]]
    target=outer[1][4]
    noise=max(max(row) for row in grid)
    # Output is the odd-sized group's template XOR its mask; the other group
    # supplies the output color. In equal-size cases XOR all four patterns.
    if len({(len(p),len(p[0])) for p in panels})==1:
        ph,pw=len(panels[0]),len(panels[0][0])
        return [[noise if sum(p[y][x]==noise for p in panels)>1
                 else target if sum(p[y][x]!=0 for p in panels)%2 else 0
                 for x in range(pw)] for y in range(ph)]
    a,b=panels[0],panels[1]
    return [[noise if a[y][x]==noise and b[y][x]==noise
             else target if (a[y][x]!=0)^(b[y][x]!=0) else 0
             for x in range(len(a[0]))] for y in range(len(a))]
